counts.rejected_note: blind-c 'breadcrumb demo segments link to real routes' rejected — links carry demo ids (v-maples) which resolve in-demo via is_demo_route.

findings.title: Demo report download always fails — wrong id mapping AND relative-URI parse error
findings.detail: Two independent bugs: drop_start(3) strips 'an-' leaving 'aoife' (not 'a-aoife'), and uri.parse of a relative path gives host=None so gleam_http request.from_uri returns Error before any fetch. Real report_api.download uses rsvp.parse_relative_uri instead. Every demo report download 404s/fails.
findings.recommended_fix: Map analysis_id 'an-X' to application_id 'a-X'; use rsvp.parse_relative_uri like report_api.download.

findings.title: Demo mutations discard the mutated store — create/edit/mark-opened are silent no-ops
findings.detail: All four demo mutation branches in client.gleam return #(next, eff) from demo_api then `let _ = next`, discarding the new store. demo_update.gleam elsewhere does Model(..model, demo_store: Some(next)) correctly. So create/edit-vacancy and mark-opened mutate nothing; the stale store re-renders after the response refetch.
findings.recommended_fix: Return Model(..model, demo_store: Some(next)) from these arms, matching demo_update.gleam's pattern.

findings.title: Bulk-reject fires a real POST from demo mode (no demo branch, not intercepted)
findings.evidence:
UserClickedMarkAllRejected(vid) -> ... application_api.bulk_reject_applications(vid, ids, "sweep_nudge", model.csrf_token, ApiReturnedBulkReject)
UserClickedMarkSelectedRejected(vid) -> ... application_api.bulk_reject_applications(...)
findings.detail: Neither message is handled by demo_update (falls through to update_inner) nor demo-branched in update_inner, so 'Mark all/selected as rejected' issues a real application_api.bulk_reject POST from demo — a live write attempt, violating the no-network pillar. demo_api.bulk_reject_applications exists but is never wired.
findings.recommended_fix: Intercept both messages in demo_update and dispatch through demo_api.bulk_reject_applications.

findings.title: Unlock CTA (unpaid v-harbour) and extend button fire real payment_api.check_consent from demo
findings.detail: v-harbour is unpaid with 1 pending application, so leaderboard_view renders the unlock CTA (is_paid=False && unscored_count>0). Clicking it falls through demo_update to real check_consent — the designed 'why pay' demo moment ends in a 401 error toast. Extend button reachable after closing a demo vacancy.
findings.recommended_fix: Hide payment surfaces in demo (demo branch -> effect.none + toast) or route through a demo stub.

findings.title: refetch_refcheck_effect has no demo branch — every demo refcheck action fires a real fetch and breaks the detail page
findings.evidence: fn refetch_refcheck_effect(model) { case model.route { routes.ApplicationDetail(vid, aid) -> application_api.fetch_application_detail(vid, aid, ApiReturnedApplicationDetail) ... } }
findings.detail: After any demo refcheck row action (skip/re-enable/start/take-over/correct), the response handler calls refetch_refcheck_effect, which hits the real application_api (no demo branch). The 401 sets application_detail: Failure(...) — the demo applicant detail page is replaced by an error page.
findings.recommended_fix: Demo-branch the refetch to demo_api.fetch_application_detail(demo_store_of(model),...).

findings.title: Restore success refetches the archived list via the real API — demo restore breaks the archived page
findings.evidence: ApiReturnedRestoreVacancy(result) -> case result { Ok(_) -> #(Model(..model, archived_vacancies: Loading, ...), vacancy_api.fetch_archived(ApiReturnedArchivedVacancies))
findings.detail: demo_update handles UserClickedRestoreVacancy via demo_api, but the Ok response arm in update_inner refetches archived vacancies through the real vacancy_api with no demo branch. In demo this 401s and the archived list renders Failure.
findings.recommended_fix: Demo-branch this refetch to demo_api.fetch_archived.

findings.title: Opening the notification dropdown fires a real fetch in demo and blanks demo notifications
findings.evidence: UserToggledNotificationDropdown -> ... case opening { True -> notification_api.fetch_notifications(on_response: ApiReturnedNotifications) ... }
findings.detail: No demo branch and not intercepted by demo_update. Opening the bell in demo issues a real notification_api GET (401), and ApiReturnedNotifications(Error) sets notifications: Failure('Couldn't load notifications') — the seeded demo notifications are wiped on the first bell open.
findings.recommended_fix: Demo-branch to demo_api.fetch_notifications, or intercept in demo_update.

findings.title: Settings/profile/password/account-deletion writes reachable in demo fire real settings_api calls
findings.evidence:
UserSubmittedProfile -> settings_api.update_profile(...)  // no demo branch
UserConfirmedAccountDeletion -> settings_api.delete_account(confirm_email: ..., csrf_token: model.csrf_token, ...)
findings.detail: Typing /settings in demo (settings link hidden but route reachable; demo auth=Success passes the protected-route check) exposes profile save, password change, notification prefs and account deletion — all fire real settings_api writes with csrf_token 'demo-csrf-token'. If a logged-in landlord enters demo, their session cookie rides along; the bogus CSRF token is the only barrier. Violates 'demo issues NO writes to real endpoints'.
findings.recommended_fix: Intercept all settings submit messages in demo_update and no-op them, or hard-block /settings in demo.

findings.title: ?payment=success and ?extended=success URL arms fire real network in demo
findings.evidence: let poll_eff = schedule_payment_poll(vid) ... let pixel_eff = payment_api.fire_pixel_purchase_for_session(session_id, msg.AppNoOp)  // no demo guard
findings.detail: A crafted URL like /vacancies/v-maples?payment=success in demo fires schedule_payment_poll and fire_pixel_purchase_for_session (real calls); ?extended=success additionally does a real vacancy_api.get_detail. Contrived but reachable.
findings.recommended_fix: Guard both arms with model.demo_mode -> effect.none().

findings.title: /billing in demo fires a real billing-history fetch
findings.evidence: routes.Billing -> ... settings_api.fetch_billing_history(on_response: ApiReturnedBillingHistory)  // no demo guard
findings.detail: Direct navigation to /billing in demo (route reachable, demo auth passes) fires a real settings_api GET. No demo branch.
findings.recommended_fix: Demo-branch or block Billing in demo.

findings.title: Refresh/deep-link on a demo edit URL boots demo but never loads the edit payload (blank form)
findings.evidence: is_demo_route includes routes.VacancyEdit(id) -> string.starts_with(id, "v-") ... demo_entry_effects case route { ... _ -> [] }  // no VacancyEdit arm
findings.detail: Refresh on /vacancies/v-maples/edit boots demo via is_demo_route but demo_entry_effects has no VacancyEdit arm, so the edit form is empty and vacancy_edit_id stays ''. handle_browser_change only fetches edit data on in-SPA navigation, not at boot.
findings.recommended_fix: Add a VacancyEdit arm to demo_entry_effects calling demo_api.get_for_edit.

findings.title: UserConfirmedApproval refetches the leaderboard from the stale (pre-mutation) store
findings.detail: demo_status returns the model with the new store, but the leaderboard refetch reads store_of(model) — the OLD store — so the just-approved applicant still renders under-review on the leaderboard. Rejection/backward transitions don't refetch at all (inconsistent).
findings.recommended_fix: Use store_of(updated), and refetch consistently for all status transitions.

findings.title: Reset demo from a non-dashboard demo page strands the page on a permanent spinner
findings.evidence: reset_demo -> Model(..model, demo_store: Some(store), ... vacancy_detail: NotAsked, leaderboard: NotAsked, application_detail: NotAsked, comparison_details: NotAsked, archived_vacancies: NotAsked, ...) + demo_api.fetch_notifications(store, ...)
findings.detail: Reset only refetches notifications; on a detail/archived/comparison route the page data goes NotAsked with no refetch effect and no route change, so the view renders a perpetual loading spinner. The banner reset button is global chrome.
findings.recommended_fix: Also push /demo (or refetch the current route's data) on reset.

findings.title: 6 of 9 demo analytics events are defined but never fired (surface-opens + downloads not captured)
findings.evidence: pub const demo_entry / demo_reset / demo_cta_click (fired) vs demo_vacancy_open / demo_application_open / demo_comparison_open / demo_archived_open / demo_report_download / demo_create_vacancy_open (never fired — grep shows no capture_event call sites)
findings.detail: Deliverable 7 requires 'capturing entry, key surfaces, downloads, CTA clicks'. Only entry/reset/CTA are wired; the six surface/download events are dead constants.
findings.recommended_fix: Wire capture_event at each surface open + download, or delete the unused constants.

findings.title: Landlord-facing copy hardcoded in views instead of copy.gleam (AGENTS.md violation)
findings.evidence: html.text("Demo - nothing is saved. This is mock data, refreshed every visit.") ... html.text("Create your vacancy →") ... html.text("↺ Reset demo")
findings.detail: AGENTS.md requires all landlord-facing strings to live in copy.gleam; the demo banner (and shell demo labels) inline them. Blocks brand-voice discipline and the em-dash lint's copy scanning.
findings.recommended_fix: Move strings to copy.gleam.

findings.title: Baked demo PDFs lack the canon-required 'Synthetic demo data — not a real applicant.' footer and carry production GDPR boilerplate
findings.evidence: pdftotext report-a-aoife.pdf -> "CONFIDENTIAL ... Contains personal data subject to the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR). Do not share, forward, or reproduce..." — no "synthetic"/"demo"/"mock" marker anywhere. Canon: "the report footer notes 'Synthetic demo data — not a real applicant.'"
findings.detail: The user-approved lavish design requires a synthetic-data footer on every report; the 8 ungated public PDFs instead carry production GDPR/confidential boilerplate with no synthetic marker. Misleading boilerplate on a public marketing asset + a canon deviation.
findings.recommended_fix: Add the synthetic-data footer via the Typst template (a footer field), and regenerate the 8 PDFs.

findings.title: Sara Walsh affordability flag says 31% of income but the fixture numbers give 72%
findings.evidence: flags: "[{\"label\":\"Rent sits at 31% of stated income — borderline\", ...}]" with income 340_000 (€3,400) and v-maples rent 245_000 (€2,450) => 72%
findings.detail: The baked report's own numbers contradict its flag copy; a landlord doing mental math sees the demo is internally inconsistent. 'The fixtures ARE the product marketing.'
findings.recommended_fix: Fix the flag to 72% (or adjust the numbers to match the story).

findings.title: Aoife co-applicant story is lost — row has count 1 but to_report_data empties co_applicants
findings.evidence: row_aoife: co_applicant_count: 1, household income 725_000 vs individual 485_000 ... to_report_data -> snapshot: ApplicationSnapshot(application: p.row, co_applicants: [], income_sources: [], documents: [])
findings.detail: The PR body touts 'product designer with co-applicant' and the row encodes a co-applicant (count 1, +€2,400 household), but the pre-bake passes empty co_applicants/income_sources/documents, so the PDF shows 'Co-applicants: 1' with no detail and no income-source breakdown.
findings.recommended_fix: Populate co_applicants/income_sources/documents in to_report_data from the row.

findings.title: Fixture uses a real person's name ('Grace Kelly') attached to a rejected/eviction/CCJ story
findings.evidence: "first_name":"Grace","last_name":"Kelly" ... "has_eviction_history":true,"eviction_details":"Rent arrears, possession order settled in 2024","has_ccjs":true,"status":"rejected"
findings.detail: The guard requires fixtures be 'obviously synthetic, no real persons'. Grace Kelly is a famous real person (deceased actress/Princess of Monaco); attaching adverse rental data to her name fails the spot-check.
findings.recommended_fix: Rename the applicant to an obviously fictional name.

findings.title: pdf_prebake main() ignores its documented CLI argument and exits 0 on failure
findings.evidence: header: "gleam run -m demo/pdf_prebake -- server/priv" ... main(): let priv_dir = "priv" ... failure branch prints "FAILED: n of m PDFs failed" and returns normally (no halt/non-zero exit)
findings.detail: The documented regeneration command only works when run from server/; run from repo root it writes to the wrong tree. Failures print but exit 0, so a scripted regeneration cannot detect that PDFs failed to bake.
findings.recommended_fix: Read argv for the priv dir; use process.halt/exit(1) on any failure.

findings.title: CI no-network lint is heuristic — does not cover client.gleam fall-through, real-api imports, or JS FFI; pillar-2 proof is prose
findings.evidence: VIOLATIONS=$(grep -rn "rsvp\|api_helpers" client/src/demo/ --include="*.gleam" ...) ; FETCH_VIOLATIONS=$(grep -rln "gleam/fetch" client/src/demo/ ... | grep -v "demo_api.gleam")
findings.detail: The lint only greps client/src/demo/ for two tokens; every real-network fall-through verified above lives in client.gleam and passes it, an `import api/vacancy_api` in a demo module passes it, and a network-capable .mjs FFI passes it. The structural guarantee is 'prose' — the actual violations are caught by the blockers, not this pin.
findings.recommended_fix: Extend the lint (ban imports of client/src/api/* and any fetch in demo/, add a fetch-spy client test).

findings.title: Demo substitute-reference save is dispatched as 'correct' — wrong action, typed referee details discarded
findings.evidence: UserSavedRefcheckEdit(call_id) -> fire_demo_refcheck(model, call_id, "correct")  // real flow distinguishes substitute (client.gleam:7277-7290)
findings.detail: In the real flow the substitute edit mode calls reference_checks_api.substitute_reference; in demo every refcheck-edit save maps to 'correct', so a substitute behaves as a correction (increments correction_cycles, keeps the old contact) and the typed referee details vanish.
findings.recommended_fix: Branch on the edit mode: substitute -> apply_refcheck 'substitute' with the new contact.

findings.title: create_vacancy sets closes_at = created_at, so a newly-created demo vacancy renders as expired/closed immediately
findings.evidence: closes_at: now  // alongside created_at: now, ignoring payload.validity_days
findings.detail: A demo create yields closes_at == created_at (days_remaining 0), so the new vacancy immediately shows as closing/closed and may surface the extend/close affordances — confusing in a demo whose point is 'create a vacancy'.
findings.recommended_fix: Set closes_at = now + validity_days.

findings.title: Demo comparison ids + sweep-nudge dismissals write to real web storage — small 'refresh=reset' exceptions
findings.evidence: UserToggledComparison -> save_comparison_ids(new_ids) ... UserDismissedSweepNudge -> save_dismissed_sweep_nudges(...)  // no demo branch
findings.detail: Comparison selections persist in sessionStorage and sweep-nudge dismissals in localStorage even in demo, and load_comparison_ids() is read back on a demo comparison entry — contradicting 'no persistence of any kind' (harmless demo ids, but a scope-guard exception).
findings.recommended_fix: Skip storage writes when demo_mode, or use a demo-scoped key.

findings.title: Demo logout fires the demo_reset PostHog event, conflating exit with reset
findings.evidence: UserClickedLogout -> { demo_analytics.capture_event(demo_analytics.demo_reset) ... }
findings.detail: Exiting the demo ('Exit demo') records demo_reset, polluting the reset metric and conflating two distinct user actions.
findings.recommended_fix: Fire a distinct demo_exit event (or none).

findings.title: Duplicate import of gleam/uri in client.gleam
findings.evidence:
import gleam/uri.{type Uri}
import gleam/uri as gleam_uri
findings.detail: The module is imported twice (typed + aliased) — a compiler warning.
findings.recommended_fix: Merge into one aliased import with the type.

findings.title: Stale doc comment — the visibilitychange-listener doc now sits on handle_browser_change
findings.evidence: /// Register a `visibilitychange` listener that silently refreshes /me each time ... /// fn handle_browser_change(
findings.detail: The comment describing listen_visibility_refresh was moved onto handle_browser_change during extraction; the listener function lost its doc.
findings.recommended_fix: Move the paragraph back to listen_visibility_refresh.

findings.title: Six demo_api refcheck mirror wrappers (substitute_reference et al.) are orphaned; several fixtures helpers unused
findings.evidence: pub fn substitute_reference(...) -> ...  // never called: demo_update dispatches via the generic refcheck_action; capture_with_props / decode_checked / all_fixture_jsons unused
findings.detail: Orphan exports leave dead code and two sources of truth for refcheck semantics (the generic action vs the mirrors).
findings.recommended_fix: Delete the unused wrappers, or wire them and drop the generic path.

findings.title: pdf_prebake ships unused imports and an unused helper
findings.evidence: GetCoApplicantsByApplicationRow / GetDocumentsByApplicationRow / GetIncomeSourcesByApplicationRow (import-only), gleam/result (no call site), fn str_opt never called
findings.detail: A brand-new module ships four unused imports and a dead helper.
findings.recommended_fix: Remove unused imports and str_opt.

findings.title: Demo breadcrumb home segment is labelled 'Dashboard' but links to /demo
findings.evidence: let home = case demo { True -> "/demo" False -> "/dashboard" } ... routes.Dashboard -> [Segment(label: "Dashboard", href: None)]
findings.detail: The demo home crumb reads 'Dashboard' while pointing at /demo — a minor label/link mismatch.
findings.recommended_fix: Label the demo home crumb 'Demo'.

findings.title: download_timeout duplicated between client.gleam and demo_update.gleam
findings.evidence: duplicate download_timeout constant/literal in both modules
findings.detail: Minor duplication; single source would avoid drift.
findings.recommended_fix: Hoist into a shared helper or demo module.

findings.title: Marta's category_scores omits rental_history (5 keys vs 6 elsewhere)
findings.evidence: category_scores: "{\"income_affordability\":...}" lacking the rental_history key present in the other seven payloads
findings.detail: Inconsistent schema across the eight baked reports (possibly intentional first-time-renter story, but undocumented).
findings.recommended_fix: Document the omission or include the key.

findings.title: Employer reference name/email mismatch (Rachel O'Brien / roberts@finlaydigital)
findings.evidence: reference name "Rachel O'Brien" with email "roberts@finlaydigital.example.com"
findings.detail: The reference's name and email local-part belong to different people — the kind of inconsistency the 'fixtures ARE the marketing' caveat warns about.
findings.recommended_fix: Align the reference name with the email.

findings.title: Demo UserClickedNotification arm doesn't close the notification dropdown (real arm does)
findings.evidence: Demo arm responds without show_notification_dropdown: False (real arm sets it)
findings.detail: After clicking a notification in demo the dropdown stays open — a UX divergence from the real handler.
findings.recommended_fix: Set show_notification_dropdown: False in the demo arm.

findings.title: Mock dashboard counts in the design artifact contradict the fixture table (8 scored vs '6 of 8')
findings.evidence: All eight scored applicants sit at The Maples (8/8 analysed), but the mock shows 6-of-8
findings.detail: The committed design artifact's own numbers disagree; the shipped fixtures have all 8 at The Maples.
findings.recommended_fix: Reconcile the counts or redistribute applicants across vacancies.

findings.title: Advisory test gate: CONCERNS — P0 pillars have non-prose pins, but download path + boot path are untested
findings.evidence: demo_flow_test hand-feeds responses; demo_api.download has zero unit coverage; client.init -> is_demo_route -> enter_demo boot path untested; no committed /demo E2E scenario
findings.detail: The no-network lint is real but narrow, the download path (the one permitted network touch) is untested, and refresh-wipe relies on architecture rather than a test.
findings.recommended_fix: Add a download test, a boot-path test, and a /demo bug-hunt scenario.
